fields.title: Motivation
fields.prompt: Fictional example prompt: Why would you like to join Example Organisation?
fields.text:
I am applying to Example Organisation because I enjoy making everyday work easier to understand and repeat. This letter is a fictional demonstration of the Runner. In a real application, I would name the role, explain why the organisation's work matters to me, and connect that interest to verified experience.

At the Imaginary Workshop, my sample task was to untangle a shared cupboard of tools. I started by asking colleagues what they needed to find, then built a small inventory and a short guide. The idea was simple: a useful system should keep working when its maker goes home. That habit of listening, testing and documenting is what I would bring to a real team.

I would welcome the chance to learn how your team works and to contribute thoughtfully. Before sending this letter, I will replace every fictional detail with my own evidence and tailor this paragraph to the actual role.
